constraints.name: doctor_schedules_doctor_id_specialty_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (doctor_id, specialty_id) REFERENCES clinic.doctor_specialties(doctor_id, specialty_id)

constraints.name: time_slots_schedule_id_tstzrange_excl
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (schedule_id WITH =, tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at, '[)'::text) WITH &&)

constraints.name: appointments_care_action_id_episode_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (care_action_id, episode_id) REFERENCES clinic.care_actions(id, episode_id)

constraints.name: appointments_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((booking_type = 'self'::text) AND (care_action_id IS NULL)) OR ((booking_type <> 'self'::text) AND (care_action_id IS NOT NULL) AND (episode_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: appointments_patient_id_tstzrange_excl
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (patient_id WITH =, tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at, '[)'::text) WITH &&) WHERE ((status = ANY (ARRAY['held'::text, 'planned'::text, 'completed'::text, 'no_show'::text])))

constraints.name: appointments_episode_id_patient_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (episode_id, patient_id) REFERENCES clinic.episodes(id, patient_id)

constraints.name: questionnaire_answers_submission_id_questionnaire_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (submission_id, questionnaire_id) REFERENCES clinic.questionnaire_submissions(id, questionnaire_id)

constraints.name: questionnaire_answers_question_id_questionnaire_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (question_id, questionnaire_id) REFERENCES clinic.questions(id, questionnaire_id)
